title: Private DNS and Private Endpoint Connectivity
description: Configure Private DNS zones so private endpoints are reachable by their standard service hostnames.

data.text: A private endpoint has a private IP address, but your application still needs to resolve the service's public DNS name to that private IP. Azure Private DNS zones handle this automatically.
When you create a private endpoint, Azure can create a Private DNS zone and link it to your VNet. This maps the service's public FQDN to the private IP address.

data.title: Private DNS Steps
items: Create a private endpoint for the Azure service
Accept the Private DNS zone suggestion (or create one manually)
Link the Private DNS zone to your VNet
Verify resolution from a VM inside the VNet

data.title: Create and Link a Private DNS Zone
data.content: Set up DNS resolution for a Key Vault private endpoint.
data.code:
# Create Private DNS zone for Key Vault
az network private-dns zone create   --resource-group myRG   --name "privatelink.vaultcore.azure.net"

# Link the zone to your VNet
az network private-dns link vnet create   --resource-group myRG   --zone-name "privatelink.vaultcore.azure.net"   --name myVNet-link   --virtual-network myVNet   --registration-enabled false

data.title: Verify DNS Resolution from a VM
data.content: SSH into a VM in the VNet and resolve the Key Vault DNS name.

data.title: Connect Private DNS to a Private Endpoint
data.description: Create a private endpoint for Azure SQL, verify the Private DNS zone, and resolve the SQL server name from a VM.
steps: Create a private endpoint for an Azure SQL server.
Create or accept the Private DNS zone 'privatelink.database.windows.net'.
Link the zone to your VNet.
Use nslookup from a VM to verify the SQL server resolves to a private IP.
data.expectedOutcome: The SQL server name resolves to a private IP inside the VNet and the public IP from outside.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Private DNS zones map service hostnames to private IPs.
Zone links connect the DNS zone to one or more VNets.
Always verify DNS resolution after creating private endpoints.
data.takeaway: A private endpoint without DNS is like a phone without a number book — it exists but no one can reach it.
